```yaml
name: FATFS Test

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  push:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  fatfs-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v3
      
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update
        sudo apt-get install -y build-essential libtool automake autoconf
        
    - name: Configure and build wolfSSH with FATFS support
      run: |
        ./configure --enable-sftp --enable-fatfs --disable-shared
        make -j$(nproc)
        
    - name: Create FATFS image file
      run: |
        # Create a 10MB FATFS image
        dd if=/dev/zero of=fatfs.img bs=1M count=10
        mkfs.fat -F 32 fatfs.img
        
    - name: Create test file
      run: |
        echo "This is a test file for FATFS integration" > test_file.txt
        
    - name: Mount FATFS image
      run: |
        mkdir -p /tmp/fatfs_mount
        sudo mount -o loop fatfs.img /tmp/fatfs_mount
        
    - name: Copy test file to FATFS
      run: |
        cp test_file.txt /tmp/fatfs_mount/
        sync
        
    - name: Unmount FATFS image
      run: |
        sudo umount /tmp/fatfs_mount
        
    - name: Run wolfsftp client test
      run: |
        # Test SFTP client with FATFS
        ./examples/sftpclient/sftpclient -H localhost -p 2222 -u testuser -f test_file.txt -r /tmp/fatfs_mount/test_file.txt
        
    - name: Verify file contents
      run: |
        # Compare original and copied files
        diff test_file.txt /tmp/fatfs_mount/test_file.txt
        echo "File verification successful!"
        
    - name: Cleanup
      if: always()
      run: |
        rm -f fatfs.img test_file.txt
        rm -rf /tmp/fatfs_mount
```
